verdict.rationale: Dialpad documents built-in AI voice and digital agents that handle customer conversations, resolve common requests and hand off to humans. That is a form of delegating work to first-party AI, but it is customer-facing and not a user-facing assistant that takes arbitrary tasks. AI CSAT scoring is analysis, not delegation. MCP support is about connecting external AI tools, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-app assistant that users can hand tasks to, documentation of which tasks can be delegated and how, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: AI voice and digital agents that handle customer conversations, resolve common requests, and hand off to human agents with full context.
